prompts.panda: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite atlas. Reference image is STYLE AND PANDA IDENTITY reference only. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite sheet arranged in an exact 4 columns by 3 rows equal grid, 1536x1152 or larger same ratio. Each cell contains exactly one full-body version of the SAME adorable cream and black panda from reference, facing RIGHT in side / slight three-quarter view, consistent body size, 15% transparent padding, no ground, no shadow outside silhouette, no props unless stated. Painterly polished 3D adventure-game art, soft detailed fur, warm golden rim light, expressive readable eyes, round belly, short limbs. Row1: idle standing; idle breathing looking up; running left foot forward; running right foot forward. Row2: jumping rising arms up; falling legs down arms spread; gliding arms wide holding one large bamboo leaf overhead; low fast dash leaning forward. Row3: staff attack holding green bamboo staff forward; hurt recoiling eyes squeezed; ground slam feet down arms tucked; victory smiling arms raised. EXACT evenly spaced 4x3 grid aligned cell centers. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no white matte, NO text, borders or scenery. Keep character identity and original adorable proportions. Actual ready-to-use sprites, not a concept presentation.
prompts.cast: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game enemy and NPC atlas. Image is STYLE reference, not a scene to copy. Make a SINGLE production sprite sheet exact 6 columns x 4 rows of 24 equal square cells, landscape 3:2 ratio, high resolution. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Exactly one isolated full-body creature per cell, centered, generous 15% empty padding, no overlap, no scenery, no lettering. Cohesive beautifully sculpted painterly 3D adventure-game style matching reference panda: rounded charming silhouettes, tactile moss/stone/fur, restrained earthy greens and warm golden rims, readable faces, slight three-quarter side view. Creatures, left to right then next row: Row1: red moss-capped mushroom with feet; sleek charcoal panther with jade eyes; translucent jade slime blob; purple spiky bat wings spread; imposing moss-covered horned mutant forest king; yellow sulfur slug. Row2: ember-colored bat; rust-red kelp armored crab; basalt stone golem with golden cracks; swirling sand spirit with face; cactus scorpion; cave spider hanging legs. Row3: glowing green worm with tiny teeth; pale blue pointed salt crystal spirit; silvery ghost; large moss mushroom spore creature; molten orange jumping lizard; teal tidal crab. Row4: violet hooded wraith; antique gold floating gravity orb drone; violet flying specter; heavy enchanted iron hammer; dark purple many-eyed void creature; friendly small elderly red panda guide in sage green cloak holding walking stick. Must be 24 distinct silhouettes, visually detailed at high resolution and readable at 40 pixels. No words, NO checkerboard painted into image, use real alpha.
prompts.world1: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D platform-game background atlas. Reference image is art-direction reference only. Create a precise 2 columns x 3 rows grid of SIX rectangular landscape environment paintings, every panel 16:9; entire sheet ratio 32:27, no gaps, borders, text or labels. Each completely fills its equal panel. Consistent polished painterly 3D storybook adventure style, textured rocks, atmospheric depth, luminous mist matching the reference forest. Camera fixed side view, distant scenery only; NO characters, NO panda, NO foreground platforms, NO ground floor, no UI. Lower third remains soft, dark and uncluttered so separately rendered game platforms are legible. Six environments in exact reading order: top-left: golden sunlit emerald bamboo forest, mossy stone lantern in deep background, warm rays; top-right: corrupted bamboo forest with muted plum mist, twisted moss roots, small amber spore lights; middle-left: ancient forest king's lair, immense tangled roots and mossy stone doorway, dark olive and antique gold; middle-right: volcanic caldera with distant molten rivers, dark basalt, ember-orange fog under charcoal sky; bottom-left: majestic coastal basalt pillars with blue-green mist and gold dusk; bottom-right: wind-carved sandstone desert canyon, sage shrubs, amber dust, warm distant sun. Distinct moods within one cohesive sophisticated world. Paint each full rectangular panel edge-to-edge, keep borders exactly at x50%, y33.333%, y66.667%.

prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game pickup / ability / scenery sprite atlas. Reference is STYLE only. Create EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equal square cells (16 total), square sheet. Each single isolated object centered inside its cell, 18% empty padding, no overlap, no text. Match reference's sophisticated painterly 3D woodland game art: textured moss, bamboo, antique gold, cream highlights, soft realistic sculpted volume. Background solid flat vivid magenta #ff00ff for game chroma-key decoding; do not use magenta anywhere on the objects. No ground shadows. Row2: pair of moss-green speed boots with small gold wings; large curved emerald bamboo glide leaf; pale aqua ice magic shard; glowing golden checkpoint stone lantern. Row3: mossy round moon-gate exit portal with golden light inside; springy mushroom cap; a tuft of detailed ferns; a suspended bronze ring portal with violet glow inside. Row4: moss-topped rectangular dark stone platform chunk, wide; ember-cracked basalt platform chunk wide; pale blue icy stone platform chunk wide; antique brass-and-dark-stone platform chunk wide. Last-row chunks each have a perfectly horizontal solid top edge, textured front side and square corners. NO symbols, lettering, borders or UI. Production game sprite sheet.
